title: crm.contact.opted_out v1
description: Emitted when a CRM contact opts out of communications. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-crm-go, staged via OutboxContactPublisher.OptedOut (internal/service/outbox_publisher.go:151-177) inside the contact-write transaction (HybridPublisher.OptedOut routes tx!=nil calls to the outbox, internal/service/hybrid_publisher.go:80-86; ADR-117 §9.B). The flat payload staged at insert time (contact_id/tenant_id/phone, outbox_publisher.go:163-167) is later wrapped by alebrije-common-go's outbox.Poller.buildEnvelope (poller.go:414-436) into the canonical envelope this schema describes: event_id = outbox row id, event_type = 'crm.contact.opted_out' (row.EventType verbatim), data = the staged flat payload verbatim. Note: this is a DISTINCT event from 'campaigns.contact.opted_out' (removed as an orphan in AUDIT-015, 974b5cb) — this one is the CRM-domain contact preference signal, not a campaigns-domain event. No schema previously existed for this event type at all (ErrNoSchema fail-open; validator currently inert fleet-wide). DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-catalog-crm-agenda.

contact_id.description: UUID of the contact that opted out (c.ID.String(), outbox_publisher.go:164).

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant (c.TenantID.String(), outbox_publisher.go:165; ADR-25). Redundant with the envelope-level tenant_id — present because the staged flat payload becomes 'data' verbatim.

phone.description: E.164 phone number of the opted-out contact (c.Phone, outbox_publisher.go:166).
